description: Download a therapy payment receipt as a PDF, by payment_id from therapyportal_list_receipts — e.g. to submit to insurance or an HSA/FSA. Saves to disk and returns the path on a local install, or returns the bytes inline (base64) on a hosted runner.

dest.description: Folder to save into (server transport, local install only). Must be inside THERAPYPORTAL_OUTPUT_DIR, or ~/Downloads / ~/Documents when that is unset.

name: therapyportal_download_receipt
